```{r}

scale_01 <- function(x) {
  q_low  <- quantile(x, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  q_high <- quantile(x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

  x_clipped <- pmin(pmax(x, q_low), q_high)

  scaled <- (x_clipped - q_low) / (q_high - q_low)
  scaled <- scaled * 0.98 + 0.01

  return(scaled)
}

```

## Risk calculation
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)

# Import combined dataset
tbd_all <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Combine spatial dataset/tbd_all.csv")

tbd_risk <- tbd_all %>%
  mutate(
    # treat zero prevalence same as NA
    Prev_aa_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_aa_scaled) & Prev_aa_scaled > 0,
                         Prev_aa_scaled, NA),
    Prev_dv_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_dv_scaled) & Prev_dv_scaled > 0,
                         Prev_dv_scaled, NA),
    Prev_is_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Prev_is_scaled) & Prev_is_scaled > 0,
                         Prev_is_scaled, NA),

    # treat zero bite same as NA
    Bite_aa_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Inc_scaled_aa_bite) & Inc_scaled_aa_bite > 0,
                         Inc_scaled_aa_bite, NA),
    Bite_dv_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Inc_scaled_dv_bite) & Inc_scaled_dv_bite > 0,
                         Inc_scaled_dv_bite, NA),
    Bite_is_adj = ifelse(!is.na(Inc_scaled_is_bite) & Inc_scaled_is_bite > 0,
                         Inc_scaled_is_bite, NA),

    # AA — fallback hierarchy
    Risk_aa = case_when(
      !is.na(Prev_aa_adj) & !is.na(Bite_aa_adj) ~
        (1/3) * PM_aa_scaled + (1/3) * Prev_aa_adj + (1/3) * Bite_aa_adj,
      !is.na(Prev_aa_adj) & is.na(Bite_aa_adj) ~
        0.5 * PM_aa_scaled + 0.5 * Prev_aa_adj,
      is.na(Prev_aa_adj) & !is.na(Bite_aa_adj) ~
        0.5 * PM_aa_scaled + 0.5 * Bite_aa_adj,
      TRUE ~ PM_aa_scaled
    ),

    # DV
    Risk_dv = case_when(
      !is.na(Prev_dv_adj) & !is.na(Bite_dv_adj) ~
        (1/3) * PM_dv_scaled + (1/3) * Prev_dv_adj + (1/3) * Bite_dv_adj,
      !is.na(Prev_dv_adj) & is.na(Bite_dv_adj) ~
        0.5 * PM_dv_scaled + 0.5 * Prev_dv_adj,
      is.na(Prev_dv_adj) & !is.na(Bite_dv_adj) ~
        0.5 * PM_dv_scaled + 0.5 * Bite_dv_adj,
      TRUE ~ PM_dv_scaled
    ),

    # IS
    Risk_is = case_when(
      !is.na(Prev_is_adj) & !is.na(Bite_is_adj) ~
        (1/3) * PM_is_scaled + (1/3) * Prev_is_adj + (1/3) * Bite_is_adj,
      !is.na(Prev_is_adj) & is.na(Bite_is_adj) ~
        0.5 * PM_is_scaled + 0.5 * Prev_is_adj,
      is.na(Prev_is_adj) & !is.na(Bite_is_adj) ~
        0.5 * PM_is_scaled + 0.5 * Bite_is_adj,
      TRUE ~ PM_is_scaled
    ),

    # method flag
    Method_aa = case_when(
      !is.na(Prev_aa_adj) & !is.na(Bite_aa_adj) ~ "Abundance + Prevalence + Bite",
      !is.na(Prev_aa_adj) & is.na(Bite_aa_adj)  ~ "Abundance + Prevalence",
      is.na(Prev_aa_adj)  & !is.na(Bite_aa_adj) ~ "Abundance + Bite",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Abundance only"
    ),
    Method_dv = case_when(
      !is.na(Prev_dv_adj) & !is.na(Bite_dv_adj) ~ "Abundance + Prevalence + Bite",
      !is.na(Prev_dv_adj) & is.na(Bite_dv_adj)  ~ "Abundance + Prevalence",
      is.na(Prev_dv_adj)  & !is.na(Bite_dv_adj) ~ "Abundance + Bite",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Abundance only"
    ),
    Method_is = case_when(
      !is.na(Prev_is_adj) & !is.na(Bite_is_adj) ~ "Abundance + Prevalence + Bite",
      !is.na(Prev_is_adj) & is.na(Bite_is_adj)  ~ "Abundance + Prevalence",
      is.na(Prev_is_adj)  & !is.na(Bite_is_adj) ~ "Abundance + Bite",
      TRUE                                        ~ "Abundance only"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Risk_aa_scaled = scale_01(Risk_aa),
    Risk_dv_scaled = scale_01(Risk_dv),
    Risk_is_scaled = scale_01(Risk_is)
  )

# Print method summary
print(as.data.frame(tbd_risk %>% count(Method_aa)))
print(as.data.frame(tbd_risk %>% count(Method_dv)))
print(as.data.frame(tbd_risk %>% count(Method_is)))

# Export
tbd_risk %>%
  select(County, Risk_aa_scaled, Risk_dv_scaled, Risk_is_scaled) %>%
  write_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled_sensitivity_analysis.csv")

cat("Saved: Vector_level_risk_scaled_sensitivity_analysis.csv\n")

```


## Plotting
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


# Import sensitivity analysis risk scores
tbd_risk <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled_sensitivity_analysis.csv")

# Common theme
bar_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x      = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.line.y      = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 11,  color = "black"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 11,  color = "black"),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "italic")
  )

# AA
plot_aa <- tbd_risk %>%
  arrange(Risk_aa_scaled) %>%
  mutate(County = factor(County, levels = County)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Risk_aa_scaled, y = County)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "grey40", width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(title = expression(italic("Amblyomma americanum")),
       x = "Risk score", y = NULL) +
  bar_theme
print(plot_aa)

# DV

  mutate(County = factor(County, levels = County)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Risk_dv_scaled, y = County)) +

  labs(title = expression(italic("Dermacentor variabilis")),

print(plot_dv)

# IS

  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
```

## Mapping
```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# Import sensitivity analysis risk scores
tbd_risk <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled_sensitivity_analysis.csv")

## MERGE
IL_shape <- st_read("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Illinois_shape_file/IL_BNDY_County_Py.shp")

IL_risk_sf <- IL_shape %>%
  dplyr::select(COUNTY_NAM, geometry) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    County_std = COUNTY_NAM %>% str_to_lower() %>% str_replace_all(" ", "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    tbd_risk %>%
      dplyr::mutate(County_std = County %>% str_to_lower() %>% str_replace_all(" ", "")) %>%
      dplyr::select(County_std, Risk_aa_scaled, Risk_dv_scaled, Risk_is_scaled),
    by = "County_std"
  )

## THEME
my_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, face = "italic"),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y     = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank()
  )

## SCALE
my_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(
  colors = c(
    "white",
    viridis::plasma(100, direction = 1)
  ),
  values = scales::rescale(c(
    0,
    seq(0.0001, 1, length.out = 100)
  )),
  na.value = "grey70",
  limits = c(0, 1),
  breaks = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00),
  labels = c("0.25", "0.50", "0.75", "1.00"),
  guide = guide_colorbar(
    direction = "vertical",
    barwidth = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    barheight = unit(4, "cm"),
    title = NULL
  )
)

## RISK MAPS
p_Risk_aa <- ggplot(IL_risk_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Risk_aa_scaled), color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.15) +
  my_scale +
  ggtitle("Risk of A. americanum") +
  my_theme
print(p_Risk_aa)

p_Risk_dv <- ggplot(IL_risk_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Risk_dv_scaled), color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.15) +
  my_scale +
  ggtitle("Risk of D. variabilis") +
  my_theme
print(p_Risk_dv)

p_Risk_is <- ggplot(IL_risk_sf) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Risk_is_scaled), color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.15) +
  my_scale +
  ggtitle("Risk of I. scapularis") +
  my_theme
print(p_Risk_is)

## SAVE PANEL
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output/Sensetivity analysis"

add_leg <- function(p) p + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right")

risk_panel <- wrap_plots(list(
  add_leg(p_Risk_aa),
  add_leg(p_Risk_dv),
  add_leg(p_Risk_is)
), ncol = 3, guides = "collect")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "panel_Risk_ticks_sensetivity_analysis.png"),
       risk_panel, width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

message("Saved: panel_Risk_ticks.png")

```



## Comoparing sensetivity analysis values with normal
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Import both risk score files
primary  <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv")

sensitiv <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled_sensitivity_analysis.csv")

# Merge by County
comparison <- primary %>%
  inner_join(sensitiv, by = "County", suffix = c("_primary", "_sens"))

# Spearman correlation tests
cat("\n--- A. americanum ---\n")
print(cor.test(comparison$Risk_aa_scaled_primary,
               comparison$Risk_aa_scaled_sens,
               method = "spearman"))

cat("\n--- D. variabilis ---\n")
print(cor.test(comparison$Risk_dv_scaled_primary,
               comparison$Risk_dv_scaled_sens,
               method = "spearman"))

cat("\n--- I. scapularis ---\n")
print(cor.test(comparison$Risk_is_scaled_primary,
               comparison$Risk_is_scaled_sens,
               method = "spearman"))

# Summary table
cor_table <- data.frame(
  Species    = c("A. americanum", "D. variabilis", "I. scapularis"),
  Spearman_r = round(c(
    cor(comparison$Risk_aa_scaled_primary, comparison$Risk_aa_scaled_sens,
        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(comparison$Risk_dv_scaled_primary, comparison$Risk_dv_scaled_sens,
        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    cor(comparison$Risk_is_scaled_primary, comparison$Risk_is_scaled_sens,
        method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  ), 3)
)
print(cor_table)


# Fancy scatter plot function — no individual legend
plot_cor <- function(data, x_col, y_col, species_label) {

  r_val <- round(cor(data[[x_col]], data[[y_col]],
                     method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]])) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color     = "#3B3B98",
                fill      = "#A8A8D8",
                alpha     = 0.3,
                linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_abline(slope     = 1,
                intercept = 0,
                linetype  = "dashed",
                color     = "red",
                linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(color = abs(.data[[x_col]] - .data[[y_col]])),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_color_gradient(
  low = "grey30",
  high = "#E84646",
  name = "Absolute difference",
  limits = c(0, 1),
  guide = guide_colorbar(
  direction = "horizontal",
  title.position = "left",
  title.theme = element_text(
    size = 10,
    vjust = 1.0,
    margin = margin(r = 6)
  ),
  barwidth = unit(5, "cm"),
  barheight = unit(0.30, "cm")
)
)  +   # fix limits same across all
    #annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.93, label = paste0("r[s] == ", r_val), parse = TRUE, size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    labs(
    title = bquote(italic(.(species_label))),
    x = "Primary risk score\n(Abundance + Prevalence)",
    y = "Sensitivity risk score\n(Abundance + Prevalence + Bite)"
     )  +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "italic"),
  axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),

  axis.title.x = element_text(
    color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold",
    margin = margin(t = 2, b = -8)
  ),

  axis.title.y = element_text(
    color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"
  ),

  legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 10),

  legend.box.margin = margin(t = -12, b = 0),
  legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
  legend.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0)
)
}

# Build plots
p1 <- plot_cor(comparison, "Risk_aa_scaled_primary",
               "Risk_aa_scaled_sens", "Amblyomma americanum")
p2 <- plot_cor(comparison, "Risk_dv_scaled_primary",
               "Risk_dv_scaled_sens", "Dermacentor variabilis")
p3 <- plot_cor(comparison, "Risk_is_scaled_primary",
               "Risk_is_scaled_sens", "Ixodes scapularis")

# Combine plots with common axis titles and shared legend
plots_row <- p1 + p2 + p3 +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 3,
    axis_titles = "collect"
  )

cor_panel <- plots_row / guide_area() +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(10, 0.65),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 3, b = 0)
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

print(cor_panel)

ggsave(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output/sensitivity_analysis_correlation.tiff",
  plot = cor_panel,
  width = 14,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

```

```{r}
# Fancy scatter plot function — no individual legend
plot_cor <- function(data, x_col, y_col, species_label) {

  r_val <- round(cor(data[[x_col]], data[[y_col]],
                     method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3)

  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = .data[[y_col]])) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color = "#3B3B98",
                fill = "#A8A8D8",
                alpha = 0.3,
                linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1,
                intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed",
                color = "red",
                linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = cut(
        abs(.data[[x_col]] - .data[[y_col]]),
        breaks = c(-Inf, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, Inf),
        labels = c("<0.05", "0.05-0.10", "0.10-0.20", ">0.20")
      )),
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "<0.05" = "grey30",
        "0.05-0.10" = "steelblue4",
        "0.10-0.20" = "goldenrod",
        ">0.20" = "firebrick"
      ),
      name = "Absolute difference"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    labs(
    title = bquote(italic(.(species_label))),
    x = "Primary risk score\n(Abundance + Prevalence)",
    y = "Sensitivity risk score\n(Abundance + Prevalence + Bite)"
    )  +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "italic"),
      axis.text    = element_text(color = "black", size = 12),
      axis.title   = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}

# Build plots
p1 <- plot_cor(comparison, "Risk_aa_scaled_primary",
               "Risk_aa_scaled_sens", "Amblyomma americanum")
p2 <- plot_cor(comparison, "Risk_dv_scaled_primary",
               "Risk_dv_scaled_sens", "Dermacentor variabilis")
p3 <- plot_cor(comparison, "Risk_is_scaled_primary",
               "Risk_is_scaled_sens", "Ixodes scapularis")

# Combine plots with common axis titles and shared legend
cor_panel <- p1 + p2 + p3 +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 3,
    guides = "collect",
    axis_titles = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",

    # reduce space between X-axis title and legend
    legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -2, b = 0),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 3, b = 0)
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 8)
    )
  )
ggsave(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output/2_sensitivity_analysis_correlation.tiff",
  plot = cor_panel,
  width = 14,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)
```
